items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1979-12-07
items.q: So we'd live from Al Jays to Walkatown, man.

ctx.x: I have a hard time believing that because I used to remember funerals that would last about four hours. Oh, some funerals would last five or six hours.

It would last four hours. I don't see how you could play three in one day. Yeah. You see, the Catholic funerals never last long. Oh. You see, if you get two Catholic funerals in the morning and one o'clock, maybe one, two o'clock, you're playing a Baptist or Protestant funeral, well you'd probably be in the street until six, seven o'clock. But you get through them Catholic funerals in no time. Now sometimes you catch a Baptist funeral that the fellow never belonged to no church and they dismiss them right from…
Um, do you think, um, you know, that the streets have changed that much? You know, like you mentioned they were getting a lot rougher.
